items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed via in-game Controls pages): WASD move; character stays screen-centered, world scrolls. Measured movement ≈75–80px/s of world distance (1.5s A-hold closed ~115px; a prior ~1s ≈100px). Space = Do Action (contextual pick/examine/harvest). Left Mouse = Primary, Right Mouse = Secondary. F = Do Attack (utility/effect still untested on mobs). Escape = Paused menu (Continue/Controls/Settings/Save and Quit); pausing halts the clock. Tab = Map (untested). Caps Lock = Open Crafting (keyboard panel, untested). '1' = Inv 1. Q/E rotate camera; scroll wheel zooms (and map zoom). Controls pages advance via right arrow; page 3 lists Pause=Esc, Map=Tab, Open Crafting=Caps Lock, Inv 1=1.

HOVER/PICK (observed): mouse hover shows verb labels 'Pick X' / 'Examine X' (e.g. Pick Flower/Grass/Sapling/Berry Bush). No label = inert scenery. Clicking scenery does nothing useful. Verb label appears at long range but picks fail beyond ~150px; reliable at ~100–130px (140 borderline). Standing on a target flips Pick→Examine; step off and retry. Hotbar updates can lag—a pick that looked failed appeared a moment later, so don't trust immediate hotbar state.

YIELDS (observed): yellow flower→Petals; red flower→Petals; sapling→Twigs x1; grass tuft→Cut Grass x1; berry bush→Berries x1. Red round ground sprite = red flower (Pick Flower), not mushroom; red mushroom pickability untested.

DEPLETION CUES (observed): depleted sapling = bare leafless branching twigs, no verb; harvested grass = 'Examine Grass' stub; harvested berry bush = pale/plucked 'Examine Berry Bush' (a bright-looking spiky plant that seemed fresh was actually a plucked berry bush—don't assume bright = available). Pine needle clusters and pine trunks both read 'Examine Evergreen' and mimic yellow-green tufts. Pale ground sprigs/sprigs/button bushes/bare branches = no verb, inert.

IDENTIFICATION CORRECTION (observed): bright tall yellow-green spiky plants are grass tufts ('Pick Grass'), NOT saplings. Leafy saplings have broad leaf clumps on a thin stem; look for those for Twigs.

HOTBAR (observed): fills in acquisition order; slot centers approx x 0.135, 0.20, 0.26, 0.32 at y≈0.93. Tooltips rarely render (one hover did reveal 'Twigs'); hover-verify but expect failures. Green icons ambiguous (Petals/Cut Grass/Twigs/Berries).

CRAFT UI (observed repeatedly): flame/Light sidebar icon near (0.019, ~0.14–0.197); left-click opens vertical recipe column x≈0.05–0.15 (Tools category shown by default with bright top tile, dark silhouette recipe tiles, lock icons and '1'—locked recipes likely need a Science Machine). Numerous left-clicks and a right-click on bright top and dark tiles produced no detail panel and no crafting effect. Craft UI open does NOT pause time. Hypotheses (unverified): bright top/bottom tiles are decorative end-caps while dark tiles are recipes; activation may need different input (right-click, double-click, drag); clicking a tile may craft directly and fail silently for lack of materials; column may scroll; Caps Lock may open a functional keyboard craft panel. Assumed unverified costs: Torch 2 Cut Grass + 2 Twigs; Campfire 3 Cut Grass + 2 Logs; Fire Pit rocks + unknown.

NIGHT (observed): dusk message 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.' then 'It's so dark!' with repeated 'OW! Something hit me!' / 'What was that?!' and red damage vignette until death; screen near-black, hard to act. Blue circular (moon) icon appears beside Day clock at night, function unknown. Night without light killed; a lit torch held through daylight previously survived Night 1. F had no observed effect when tried.

HUNGER (observed): 'I'm so hungry!' warning appears; Petals hover shows 'Eat'. Whether eating restores hunger untested; berries likely food (untested).

TERRAIN/NAVIGATION (observed): start = open burrow-heavy brown ground with rabbit holes, yellow flowers, red mushrooms, butterflies, birds, sparse saplings. Long east/southeast runs = burrow savanna, no grass field. Pine barrens hold grass tufts at trunk bases but many pines/saplings are depleted; berry bushes and saplings also occur there. Dense pine grove southwest/west with plentiful grass and many bare (depleted) saplings. A richer cluster field (several grass tufts, a sapling, red and yellow flowers) was found after long travel west/southwest—best harvest area, worth returning toward. Heading southeast into open savanna revealed fresh leafy ('Pick Sapling') saplings. Red birds roam; a very large red bird landed nearby—capabilities/hostility unknown, avoid for now.

FAILED/WASTEFUL (observed): click-to-harvest; Space beyond ~150px; standing on target; hovering trunks/needles; treating sprigs/button bushes as pickable; treating bright spiky plants as saplings; spending late daylight on unresponsive craft UI; clicking bright end-cap tiles; left- and right-clicking silhouette recipe tiles; wandering in darkness; starting crafting at dusk; assuming all green icons are Cut Grass; trusting immediate hotbar update after a pick.

LESSONS/HYPOTHESES FOR NEXT ATTEMPT (unverified): daylight is a hard deadline—gather 3+ Twigs and 3+ Cut Grass surplus early, then craft light in early/mid afternoon while the UI can still be debugged. Seek leafy saplings (broad leaf clumps) for Twigs; depleted saplings stay bare, so move on. Berry bushes supply food; test eating petals/berries when hunger warns. Use Caps Lock to try the keyboard craft panel; use Tab map to locate resources. Walk to ~100–130px and confirm by hover before Space. Locked (padlock) recipes likely require a Science Machine; Torch should sit under the Light/flame category and be craftable without science. Open questions: blue moon icon function; eating mechanics; F attack utility; whether the craft column scrolls; whether a campfire/fire pit is a cheaper alternative to a torch; whether/science machine availability.

ACTIVE GOALS: craft a light source before nightfall (torch or fire), accumulate surplus Twigs/Cut Grass, secure food (berries/petals), return to the rich west/southwest field, and resolve craft-panel activation.
